data.message: I commit to 18 tons and invite each of the other 24 to opt in individually—not an all-or-nothing deal. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). Switching earns $8,000 extra now if fulfilled, but leaves8 fewer tons and16 fewer next month in the 25% outcome. At all18, 50 remain; next stock is500 or100. Long-run gains aren't guaranteed; intentions aren't enforceable. Each person: what exact catch do you intend, and does it depend on others?
